_note: Spike test sentences written for CrispPlay (not taken from any game script). 'tr' is a hand-written reference; 'tags' mark what the line stresses. 'speaker' lines are rendered as 'NAME: text'. 'ctx' is the id of the previous line of the same conversation (for the short-line context test).

sentences.en: Get down! They're flanking us from the left!
I told you not to trust him.
We need to reach the extraction point before sunrise.
sentences.tr: Gün doğmadan tahliye noktasına ulaşmamız gerek.

sentences.en: You've got to be kidding me.
Stay close.
Arthur, we ain't got much time. The law's coming.
sentences.tr: Arthur, fazla vaktimiz yok. Kanun adamları geliyor.

sentences.en: Take the shot whenever you're ready.
That was close. Too close.
sentences.tr: Kıl payı kurtulduk. Fazla kıl payı.

sentences.en: He owes me 500 dollars and I want it by Friday.

sentences.en: What the hell happened here?

sentences.tr: Çatıda düşman keskin nişancı, saat iki yönünde!

sentences.en: I don't know who you are, but you saved my life.
sentences.tr: Kim olduğunu bilmiyorum ama hayatımı kurtardın.

sentences.en: Find the key card. It should be somewhere in the office.

sentences.en: Boy!

sentences.en: She said she'd meet us at the old bridge at midnight.

sentences.en: Nobody leaves until I get some answers.

sentences.en: Reloading! Cover me!

sentences.en: Screw this, I'm out of here.

sentences.en: Head north, past the river. You can't miss it.

sentences.en: I'm sorry, Ellie. I should have told you the truth.

sentences.en: Three guards at the gate, two more on the wall.
sentences.tr: Kapıda üç muhafız, surda iki tane daha.

sentences.en: Why are you doing this?
Because someone has to.
Hold the line! Don't let them through!

The password is 4-7-1-9. Don't forget it.

sentences.en: Easy, girl. Nobody's going to hurt you.

sentences.en: I've seen things you wouldn't believe.
Out of ammo!
Is that all you've got?

Dude, that was awesome! Let's do it again!

sentences.en: Put the gun down and nobody gets hurt.
It's been a long time, old friend.
Dr. Kovacs wants to see you in the lab right away.

sentences.en: They burned the whole village to the ground.
No way.
I'll hold them off. You get the others to safety.

sentences.en: The engine's busted. We're not going anywhere.

sentences.en: Watch your step. The floor is rotten.

Meet me behind the saloon in ten minutes. Come alone.

sentences.en: Your sword is sharp, but your mind is dull.

sentences.en: Hey, you! Stop right there!

Grab whatever you can carry and let's get out of here.

sentences.en: Level 3 clearance required. Access denied.
